title: Belt Buckle
description: While you have no potions, you have [blue]2[/blue] additional [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Grants +2 Dexterity while you have no potions. The bonus is applied immediately after obtaining the relic (if in combat), at the start of combat, and whenever your potion inventory becomes empty. It is removed when you obtain potions and reapplied if you use or discard all remaining potions.
